title: Directive Principles & State Policies
description: Learn about the guidelines for governance given to the State in Part 4 of Nepal's Constitution.

sections.title: Purpose and Nature
sections.content: Directive principles and state policies articulate aspirational goals—social justice, equitable development, environmental stewardship—guiding legislative and executive action though not directly enforceable in courts.

sections.title: Implementation Mechanisms
sections.content: Plans, budgets, and sectoral strategies operationalize principles. Monitoring frameworks track progress toward inclusive growth and sustainability targets.

sections.title: Balancing Rights and Policies
sections.content: While not enforceable like fundamental rights, these principles shape interpretation and prioritization in governance decisions, influencing equitable resource allocation.

sections.title: Evaluation and Challenges
sections.content: Data limitations, coordination gaps, and funding constraints challenge full realization. Strengthening metrics and inter-agency collaboration improves outcomes.

summary: Challenges include data and coordination gaps
